name: @factbag/core
description: A four-valued logic runtime and DSL for explainable fact and rule evaluation.

scripts.api-report: api-extractor run --local --config api-extractor.dsl.json && api-extractor run --local --config api-extractor.kb.json && api-extractor run --local --config api-extractor.query.json && api-extractor run --local --config api-extractor.explain.json
scripts.api-report:check: api-extractor run --config api-extractor.dsl.json && api-extractor run --config api-extractor.kb.json && api-extractor run --config api-extractor.query.json && api-extractor run --config api-extractor.explain.json
scripts.build: node ../../scripts/clean-output.ts dist && tsup src/dsl/index.ts src/knowledge-base/index.ts src/query/index.ts src/explanation/index.ts --format esm --target node22 --platform node --splitting --sourcemap --out-dir dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly && node ../../scripts/fix-declaration-specifiers.ts dist
